attempts.sql: SELECT f.file_id, f.line_count FROM code.file_profile f WHERE f.directory = 'rich' AND f.is_test = FALSE AND f.line_count >= 100 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.imports i WHERE i.imported_file_id = f.file_id AND i.is_internal) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.files t WHERE t.is_test AND t.file_id = 'rich/test_' || f.file_name) ORDER BY f.file_id

request:
Which Python files sitting directly in the rich/ folder (not in its subfolders) are at least 100 lines long yet have no test file associated with them, where a test is associated when it imports the file or its name is test_<filename>.py? Give the file path and its line count.

Requested output columns: file_id (string), line_count (integer).
explanation: Selects non-test files located directly in the rich/ directory with at least 100 lines. It excludes files that are imported by any internal file or that have a corresponding test_<filename>.py test file.
sql: SELECT f.file_id, f.line_count FROM code.file_profile f WHERE f.directory = 'rich' AND f.is_test = FALSE AND f.line_count >= 100 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.imports i WHERE i.imported_file_id = f.file_id AND i.is_internal) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.files t WHERE t.is_test AND t.file_id = 'rich/test_' || f.file_name) ORDER BY f.file_id
